author: Zephyr I
title: Replicate nodil-bottleneck variant (std-width d=5) + Double-Step LN-ConvLSTM — BASE_SEED=7
abstract: Replication of the 83.4 nodil-bottleneck variant (ID 273): std-width 32/64 CNN, main-conv dilation d=5, bottleneck 3×3 undilated, double-step LN-ConvLSTM(64), single-head AttnPool, AdamW+clip; no feature engineering. BASE_SEED=7.
